sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Slow in answering. Thoughtless ; staring.
Involuntary sighing. Complete unconsciousness. Picks
lips and clothes.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Forehead wrinkled in folds. Cold sweat.
Stupefying headache. Holts head day and night ; ; moan-
ing, sudden screams. Bores head into pillow; beats it
with hands. Dull pain in occiput, with sensation of
water swashing inside. Headache culminates in vomit-
ing.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Eyeballs turn upwards ; squinting, vacant look.
Pupils dilated. Eyes wide open, sunken. Night blind-
ness.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Dirty, dry nostrils. Rubs nose. Smell
diminished. Nose pointed.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Pale, sunken. Cold sweat. Wrinkled. Neu-
ralgia on left side; parts so tender he cannot chew.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Horrible smell from 7nouth. Lips dry and
cfacked. Tongue red and dry. Falling of lower jaw.
Meaningless picking of lips. Grinding of teeth. Chew-
mg motion. Greedily swallows cold water, though un-
conscious. Child nurses greedily, with disgust for food.
Ptyalisin, with sore corners of mouth.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Gurgling, as if bowels were full of wa-
ter. Swollen, painful to touch.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Jelly-like, ^yhite mucus ;* involuntary

Urine, — Suppressed; scanty, dark; coffee-grounds
sediment. Frequent urging. Child cannot urinate.
Bladder overdistended.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Frequent sighing. Respiration irregu-
lar. Chest constricted; gasps for breath. Hydrothorax.
[Merc, sulph.\

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Automatic motion of one arm and leg.
Limbs heavy and painful. Stretching of limbs. Thumb

372 HELLEBORUS — HELIANTHUS — HELODERMA

drawn into palm. [C«/>r.] Vesicular eruption between
fingers and toes.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Sudden screams in sleep. Soporous sleep.
Cri encephalique. Cannot be fully aroused.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Pale, dropsical, itching. Livid spots on skin.
Sudden, watery, swelling of skin. Falling off of hair
and nails.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, from evening until morning,
from uncovering.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Hcllebor. fcetidus or, Polymnia
(splenic affections, chronic ague cake; hypertrophied
uterus; glandular enlargements; hair and nails falling
off; skin peeling) ; Hcllebor. orientalis (salivation).

Antidote: Camphor; Cinch.

Compare: Threatening effusion; Tuberc.; Apis;
Zinc.; Opium; Cinch.; Cicuia; Iodoform.

of eyes with insensibility to light, chewing motion of
mouth, and sopor.

iFor a whole week has lain only upon back in apparent

albuginea dim and dull, as if covered with dust, with
dry mucus in corners of eyes ; eyes sunken, surrounded
by blue circles, with squinting towards nose; face pale
and emaciated; nose pointed, orifices sooty; lips dry

bites spoon without being aroused from apathetic con-
dition; distorts face ; chewing motion of mouth; grasps
head with hands; grinding of teeth; cramps in muscles
of back; constipation; involuntary urination; partial

of mouth; easily angered, especially after being kindly
spoken to; strikes about him; face pale and bloated;
dulness and drowsiness; frequently starts up shrieking

jaw.
